basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast and retro gaming aficionado from Portland, Oregon. I have a penchant for exploring the latest in emulation technology, particularly focusing on retro gaming consoles and handheld devices. My interests lie in discovering new ways to bring old games back to life, often through platforms like RetroArch. By day, I work as a software developer for a startup, and by night, I dive into the world of emulation and gaming. I'm in a relationship and enjoy spending weekends hiking with my partner. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on lazy Sunday afternoons.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in emulation and retro gaming stems from a combination of formal education in computer science and years of self-taught experimentation. I have built my own gaming rigs and frequently mod devices to optimize performance for emulation. I enjoy sharing my knowledge with the community and learning from others' experiences.
